title: work-source input
description: Input of the extension point orch:work-source: claim a piece of work, brief it, register its outcome, commit it, release it, add a note to the journal of its collection, or save the research result of a piece of work.

runId.description: Id of the orchestration run; it is also the owner session of the claimed work and part of the attempt id, so it uses the attempt-id characters and leaves room for the reference.

attemptId.description: Key of one attempt at the work.

actor.description: Provider, model and optional reasoning effort of an actor.

provider.description: Provider identifier, such as claude-code or codex.

claim.description: Claim one piece of work for a run: the first of items, or the next ready one of the source.

plan.description: Work source collection, such as a plan id or path.

plans_root.description: Folder that holds the collection, when not the default.

items.description: Candidate references in order; without it the source picks the next ready piece.
Reference of a piece of work.

batch.description: The claim is part of a batch of one run: a piece an earlier claim of the batch started and that has no attempt yet may be taken over. Optional.

orch_config.description: Invocation configuration file of the orch command that claims; the source passes it back to orch when it asks orch.

brief.description: Build the content-addressed brief of a claimed piece of work.

plan.description: Work source collection, such as a plan id or path.

plans_root.description: Folder that holds the collection, when not the default.

ref.description: Reference of the piece of work.

unit.description: Part of the piece of work to brief, when only one part is run.

register.description: Register the outcome of a piece of work: owner fencing and the evidence gate first, then the record.

plan.description: Work source collection, such as a plan id or path.

plans_root.description: Folder that holds the collection, when not the default.

ref.description: Reference of the piece of work.

run_id.description: Run that claimed the work; it must still own it.

attempt_id.description: Attempt being registered; a repeat is a no-op.

evidence.description: Check-evidence file of each acceptance check, by check id.

commit.description: Create one commit of a registered piece of work: its changed paths and its artifacts, as the source scopes commits.

plan.description: Work source collection, such as a plan id or path.

plans_root.description: Folder that holds the collection, when not the default.

ref.description: Reference of the piece of work.

paths.description: Repository paths the commit owns beyond the scope of the piece of work, such as its artifact folder.

release.description: Give back a claimed piece of work that was stopped before any work began: the source takes the claim off the run, so that a later run can claim it again. Optional: a source without it keeps the claim.

plan.description: Work source collection, such as a plan id or path.

plans_root.description: Folder that holds the collection, when not the default.

ref.description: Reference of the piece of work.

reason.description: Why the claim is given back.

note.description: Add a note to the journal of a collection of the source, for work that has no piece of its own there (support work of a plan or phase). Optional: a source without it answers that the operation is unsupported and the work goes on.

collection.description: Work source collection, such as a plan id or path.

plans_root.description: Folder that holds the collection, when not the default.

refs.description: References inside the collection the note belongs to, such as a phase or an item.

items.description: Reference of a piece of work or of a group of them.

research.description: Save the closed research-result of a piece of work where the source keeps its research (a plan: the research folder of the plan, declared as an input of the item). Optional: a source without it answers that the operation is unsupported and the result stays in the artifacts of the run.

plan.description: Work source collection, such as a plan id or path.

plans_root.description: Folder that holds the collection, when not the default.

ref.description: Reference of the piece of work the research serves.

number.description: Ordinal of the research of this piece of work, from 1.

result.description: The research-result of the researcher role.
